arxiv-2206-09956.title: Ising Machines for Diophantine Problems in Physics
arxiv-2206-09956.creator: Steven A. Abel, Luca A. Nutricati
arxiv-2206-09956.description: Abstract Diophantine problems arise frequently in physics, in for example anomaly cancellation conditions, string consistency conditions and so forth. We present methods to solve such problems to high order on annealers that are based on the quadratic Ising Model. This is the intrinsic framework for both quantum annealing and for common forms of classical simulated annealing.

arxiv-2210-17536.title: Strong convergence rates for full-discrete approximations of stochastic Burgers equations with multiplicative noise
arxiv-2210-17536.creator: Martin Hutzenthaler, Robert Link
arxiv-2210-17536.description: Abstract In this article we establish strong convergence rates on the whole probability space for explicit full-discrete approximations of stochastic Burgers equations with multiplicative trace-class noise. The key step in our proof is to establish uniform exponential moment estimates for the numerical approximations.

arxiv-2301-04971.title: Fully-dynamic risk measures: horizon risk, time-consistency, and relations with BSDEs and BSVIEs
arxiv-2301-04971.creator: Giulia Di Nunno, Emanuela Rosazza Gianin
arxiv-2301-04971.description: Abstract In a dynamic framework, we identify a new concept associated with the risk of assessing the financial exposure by a measure that is not adequate to the actual time horizon of the position. This will be called horizon risk . We clarify that dynamic risk measures are subject to horizon risk, so we propose to use the fully-dynamic version.

arxiv-2305-20014.creator: Laurenţiu Bubuianu, SRTV - Studioul TVR Iaşi and University Appolonia , 2 Muzicii street, Iaşi, 700399, Romania, Sergiu I. arxiv-2305-20014.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Laurenţiu Bubuianu, SRTV - Studioul TVR Iaşi and University Appolonia , 2 Muzicii street, Iaşi, 700399, Romania, Sergiu I. Vacaru, Department of Physics, California State University at Fresno, Fresno, CA 93740, USA;, Institute of Applied-Physics and Computer Sciences, Kotsyubinsky 2, Chernivtsi, 580. We extend to a theory of nonassociative geometric flows a string-inspired model of nonassociative gravity determined by star product and R-flux deformations.

arxiv-2307-00670.title: Automatic MILP Solver Configuration By Learning Problem Similarities
arxiv-2307-00670.creator: Abdelrahman Hosny, Sherief Reda
arxiv-2307-00670.description: Abstract A large number of real-world optimization problems can be formulated as Mixed Integer Linear Programs (MILP). MILP solvers expose numerous configuration parameters to control their internal algorithms. Solutions, and their associated costs or runtimes, are significantly affected by the choice of the configuration parameters, even when problem instances have the same number of decision variables and constraints.

arxiv-2312-07695.title: Non-mechanical steering of the optical beam in spectral-domain Optical Coherence Tomography
arxiv-2312-07695.creator: Daniel F. Urrego, Gerard J. Machado, Juan P. Torres
arxiv-2312-07695.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Daniel F. Urrego, Gerard J. Machado, Juan P. Torres. We demonstrate in a proof-of-concept experiment spectral-domain optical coherence tomography where steering of the optical beam that probes the sample in a transverse scan does not make use of any mechanical element. Steering is done with the help of a spatial light modulator, that introduces a spatially-dependent phase between the two orthogonal polarization components of an optical beam, and some optical elements that control the polarization of light.

arxiv-2312-08302.title: Large and complex X-ray time lags from black hole accretion disks with compact inner coronae Large and complex X-ray time lags from black hole accretion disks with compact inner coronae – C 2023
arxiv-2312-08302.creator: Phil Uttley, Julien Malzac
arxiv-2312-08302.description: Abstract Black hole X-ray binaries in their hard and hard-intermediate states display hard and soft time lags between broadband noise variations (high-energy emission lagging low-energy and vice versa), which could be used to constrain the geometry of the disk and Comptonising corona in these systems.

arxiv-2411-12507.title: Fifty Years After the Discovery of the First Stellar-Mass Black Hole: A Review of Cyg X-1
arxiv-2411-12507.creator: Jiachen Jiang
arxiv-2411-12507.description: Abstract Around 50 years ago, the famous bet between Stephen Hawking and Kip Thorne on whether Cyg X-1 hosts a stellar-mass black hole became a well-known story in the history of black hole science. Today, Cyg X-1 is widely recognised as hosting a stellar-mass black hole with a mass of approximately 20 solar masses.

arxiv-2508-04015.title: A Novel Hierarchical Co-Optimization Framework for Coordinated Task Scheduling and Power Dispatch in Computing Power Networks
arxiv-2508-04015.creator: Haoxiang Luo, Kun Yang, Qi Huang, Schahram Dustdar
arxiv-2508-04015.description: Abstract The proliferation of large-scale artificial intelligence and data-intensive applications has spurred the development of Computing Power Networks (CPNs), which promise to deliver ubiquitous and on-demand computational resources. However, the immense energy consumption of these networks poses a significant sustainability challenge. Simultaneously, power grids are grappling with the instability introduced by the high penetration of intermittent renewable energy sources (RES).

pmc-10628133.title: Tracing cancer evolution and heterogeneity using Hi-C
pmc-10628133.creator: Dan Daniel Erdmann-Pham, Sanjit Singh Batra, Timothy K Turkalo, James Durbin, Marco Blanchette, Iwei Yeh, Hunter Shain, Boris C Bastian, Yun S Song, Daniel S Rokhsar, Dirk Hockemeyer
pmc-10628133.description: Chromosomal rearrangements can initiate and drive cancer progression, yet it has been challenging to evaluate their impact, especially in genetically heterogeneous solid cancers. To address this problem we developed HiDENSEC, a new computational framework for analyzing chromatin conformation capture in heterogeneous samples that can infer somatic copy number alterations, characterize large-scale chromosomal rearrangements, and estimate cancer cell fractions.

pmc-10751596.title: Prediction of 2-Year Cognitive Outcomes in Very Preterm Infants Using Machine Learning Methods

pmc-11403014.title: HDL Levels as a Novel Predictor of Long-Term Adverse Outcomes in Patients with Heart Failure: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-11403014.creator: Aihaidan Abudouwayiti, Sureya Yisimayili, Ruzeguli Tuersun, Salamaiti Aimaier, Didaer Yisha, Xing Yan Zhang, Ying-Ying Zheng, Ailiman Mahemuti
pmc-11403014.description: BackgroundThe role of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL-C) in heart failure (HF) outcomes is contentious. We aimed to assess HDL-C’s prognostic value in HF patients.MethodsIn this retrospective cohort study (2012–2022) at the First Affiliated Hospital of Xinjiang Medical University, we analyzed 4442 patients, categorized by HDL-C quartiles.

pmc-11509301.title: High-Temperature Creep Resistance of FeAlOY ODS Ferritic Alloy
pmc-11509301.creator: Petr Dymáček, Milan Jarý, Denisa Bártková, Natália Luptáková, Štepán Gamanov, Petr Bořil, Vjaceslav Georgiev, Jiří Svoboda, Elena Villa
pmc-11509301.description: A significant effort in optimizing the chemical composition and powder metallurgical processing led to preparing new-generation ferritic coarse-grained ODS alloys with a high nano-oxide content. The optimization was aimed at high-temperature creep and oxidation resistance at temperatures in the range of 1100–1300 °C. An FeAlOY alloy, with the chemical composition Fe–10Al–4Cr–4Y2O3 (wt. %), seems as the most promising one.

pmc-12613573.title: Synthetic lethality of EZH2 and DNMT Inhibition suppresses neuroblastoma proliferation via MYCN destabilization
pmc-12613573.creator: Yuki Endo, Ryuichi P. Sugino, Hisanori Takenobu, Kyosuke Mukae, Ryu Okada, Yoshitaka Shinno, Masayuki Haruta, Shunpei Satoh, Jesmin Akter, Naoko Hattori, Atsuko Nakazawa, Toshikazu Ushijima, Akira Nakagawara, Miki Ohira, Masaki Nio, Takehiko Kamijo
pmc-12613573.description: BackgroundEnhancer of Zeste Homolog 2 (EZH2) is highly expressed in various cancers and is thought to contribute to cancer malignancy through the methylation of lysine 27 on histone H3 (H3K27). Therefore, EZH2 is an H3K27 methylase and a target of cancer epigenetic treatments. Here, we investigated the effects and functions of a small-molecule EZH2 inhibitor (EZH2i) in aggressive neuroblastoma (NB).

pmc-13111900.title: Post‐Oviposition Embryonic Staging Scheme for the Delicate Skink, Lampropholis delicata
pmc-13111900.creator: Jinglin Wen, Oliver William Griffith
pmc-13111900.description: Skinks are an important model in evolutionary research because they have evolved a suite of features of interest in vertebrate biology, from limb loss to viviparity. Furthermore, they have been a model for understanding ecophysiology and behavior, particularly the impact of climate change on ectothermic animals.

pmc-13601364.title: Late perforation of the jejuno-jejunal anastomosis following Roux-en-Y gastric bypass: A rare clinical observation
pmc-13601364.creator: Houssein Haidar Ahmad, Maryana ELMassri, Rana Ibrahim
pmc-13601364.description: remain vigilant for uncommon late complications that may present with nonspecific clinical manifestations. Among these, delayed perforation of the jejuno-jejunal (JJ) anastomosis is exceptionally rare, with an incidence reported to be less than 1% [8], [9], [10]. Owing to its rarity and potentially life-threatening consequences, prompt recognition and surgical intervention are essential.

pmc-13626756.title: Dual promoter architecture of NFE2L2 underlies isoform-specific translational control of NRF2
pmc-13626756.creator: Alicja Sznarkowska, Zuzanna Urban-Wójciuk, Alicja Dziadosz-Brzezińska, Maciej Cieśla, Sara Kusiński, Kevork Wakimian, Alicja Szabelska-Beręsewicz, Elżbieta Chruściel, Ines Papak, Natalia Marek-Trzonkowska, Artur Piróg, Witold Rzyman
pmc-13626756.description: Transcription factor NRF2 (encoded by the NFE2L2 gene) is a central signalling hub that coordinates antioxidant, detoxification, anti-inflammatory and metabolic programmes to maintain cellular homeostasis, with broad relevance to degenerative diseases, chronic inflammation and cancer. NFE2L2 is transcribed from two promoters: the canonical promoter (P1) and an alternative promoter (P2), generating transcripts that differ solely in their first exon.

pmc-13631886.title: Effects of moisture content on the co-oxidation behavior of sturgeon myofibrillar protein and sturgeon oil
pmc-13631886.creator: Yizhou Fang, Zhengmei Yin, Jinshui Yu, Guangrong Huang, Junhui Li
pmc-13631886.description: This study systematically investigated the moisture-dependent regulation of marine protein–lipid co-oxidation across a broad moisture range (10–90%), with particular emphasis on the poorly understood intermediate-moisture region. Protein and lipid oxidation exhibited a non-linear response to increasing moisture content, first intensifying and then declining, with the most extensive co-oxidation observed at 70% MC.
